summary: Map present array elements in ascending index order while preserving holes and the initial length boundary.

target.notes: Snapshot length before iteration; for each k below that length perform a property-presence check, skip absent indices, Get the current value when present, and invoke the callback through canonical JsFunction.Call with (value, k, array). Preserve skipped positions as holes in the result. Under this rule the result is the builtin Array species.

semantics.callback_this: thisArg or undefined via canonical call semantics
semantics.callback_callable_check: TypeError before iteration if callback is not callable

caveats: Custom Symbol.species is owned by array.custom-species.runtime.
A direct LINQ Select is unsafe when holes, deletion during iteration, callback this binding, or JS call semantics are observable.

tests.name: preserves holes and callback is not invoked for them
tests.input: const a=[1,,3]; let n=0; const r=a.map((v,i)=>{n++;return v*2}); console.log(n,r.length,1 in r,r[0],r[2]);

tests.name: length is snapshotted and deleted future elements are skipped
tests.input: const a=[1,2,3]; const seen=[]; const r=a.map((v,i)=>{seen.push(v); if(i===0){a.push(4); delete a[2];} return v*10;}); console.log(seen.join(','),r.length,2 in r,r[0],r[1]);
